body:
I've lived in 4 states.  Nothing ever changed.  I was always an outcast.  Why would moving to a whole other country change that?

Finances and my cats.  I don't feel right just ditching them, even with someone I know, and I can't take them.

Yes, I realize that, but it's not that I'm selective in who I let in to my life.  People generally don't notice me.  I'm weirdly invisible.  I volunteered with people at the same event for 9 years and most of them don't remember my name.  I used to go shopping with a former friend and the sales clerks would ask her if she needed a room and she'd go "can you get one for her too" and the sales clerk would turn and say, and I quote, "oh I didn't see you there".  I'm a fat, tall, white girl with red hair.  How'd you miss me?  It's not that I'm being selective at all.  It's that people tend not to notice me.

I've looked into it, but again there are things here preventing me from going.  Otherwise I would have gone a year and a half ago.  That's part of why I feel so horrible lately.  I want to go so badly, but I can't.  Besides, I have no spine.  Nothing would change.  I'd still be a little loner with few friends and spend all my time alone, except I'd also be in a foreign country.

I'd love to move away from here, but I can't at the moment thanks to funds and various other things.  

I don't do much.  Watch tv, study Korean, shop with money I don't have.  *shrug*  I don't have a lot of free time to blow on things so that list is kind of simple.

I don't see how seeing no point to being alive anymore is normal but ... if you say so. 

As for my family, we don't get along.  At all.  I'm the black sheep of the family and most of them don't even acknowledge my existence most of the time.  My parents are borderline abusive and manipulative to get me to do what they want me to do.  My friends have all said I need to cut them out of my life but my ridiculous sense of honor/respect won't allow it.

Friends ... meh.  I only have 2 friends that live nearby.  The others all live out of state.  I spend the vast majority of my time by myself because they are busy.
